THE NEIGHBOURS: CASE #110

Houses do not forget. Between what’s said and unsaid nothing truly disappears it only learns where to hide.  When 30-year-old architect Aarav Kapoor is found dead on his living room floor, the suspect pool is small: six close-knit friends bound by proximity, borrowed time, and buried secrets. There is no blood, no forced entry, and no noise.  But perfect facades always crack. The victim secretly met someone at a luxury hotel, lying to his wife about his whereabouts. His grieving wife swears she was out partying all night, but her cell phone pinged just steps away from his body. A hidden receipt, three used wine glasses on the counter, and a single broken fingernail turn a quiet tragedy into a web of deceit.  Step into the shoes of the lead detective in this immersive, tactile mystery. You won’t just read about the crime you will hold the actual case files in your hands to unravel the truth

 

Most crimes announce themselves with chaos. This one whispered. Do you have what it takes to read between the lines and uncover the killer next door?  Step past the police line. Open the case file. Uncover the truth.

Ignite your child’s curiosity with the Shumee Wooden Activity Triangle — a multi-functional learning tool designed to make preschool concepts fun and tactile.

Featuring five unique play surfaces, this toy is built to grow with your toddler. From spinning alphabet blocks to a classic abacus and a chalkboard for creative doodles, it offers endless ways to keep little minds engaged. Crafted from high-quality, eco-friendly wood, it is a sturdy and safe addition to any playroom, encouraging hours of focused, independent play.

From playing to learning, this triangle boosts fine motor skills, sensory exploration, creativity, and independent play — all while keeping your child happily engaged.
